test.name: spec 0040 AC-19 valkey_9_1_survives_planned_restart_and_sigkill in the launchd gui domain

expected: cargo test -p stacklyd --test native_launchd valkey_9_1_survives_planned_restart_and_sigkill -- --ignored, run in the launchd gui domain with the Valkey 9.1.2 artifact in the xtask runtime cache, keeps the pid and startedAt of a running Valkey instance through stackly daemon restart and a SIGKILL of stacklyd, so HandoverProof official/valkey line 1 spec-0040-ac-19 can be added to HANDOVER_PROVEN
reason: the test runs stacklyd as a LaunchAgent in the launchd gui domain of the user's login session and ends that session with launchctl kickstart -k and bootout; the scope 07 rules leave launchd runs to the user, so this tester session (tst-f40-test) did not run it. The parts that need no launchd job are covered: official_valkey_has_no_handover_proof_before_its_launchd_record_passes (crates/core/tests/provider_packages.rs) and a_restart_preview_stops_and_restores_a_valkey_instance_while_its_handover_is_unproven (apps/daemon/tests/native_launchd.rs, cached artifact only)
steps: on this Mac, logged in to the GUI session, with the Valkey 9.1.2 artifact valkey-9.1.2-r2-macos-aarch64 in the xtask runtime cache
from a clean HEAD run `cargo xtask evidence run --kind native -- cargo test -p stacklyd --test native_launchd --locked -- --ignored valkey_9_1_survives_planned_restart_and_sigkill`
expect the test to pass with the same valkey-server pid and startedAt through `stackly daemon restart` and a SIGKILL of stacklyd
on PASS, add HandoverProof::new("official/valkey", "1", "spec-0040-ac-19") to HANDOVER_PROVEN and flip official_valkey_has_no_handover_proof_before_its_launchd_record_passes
